name: Sting of the Scorpid

angles.text: For young orcs coming of age in the Valley of Trials, hunting venomous scorpids is an essential trial of endurance and battlefield awareness overseen by Gornek.
Darkspear trolls training alongside the Horde in the Valley of Trials must also prove their prowess against the local scorpids before venturing deeper into Durotar.
Gornek treats the scorpid hunt as a fundamental lesson in martial resolve, reminding warriors that decisive strikes overcome tough carapaces and that arrogance against smaller foes invites defeat.

aliases: who gives sting of the scorpid
faq.answer: Gornek, the battlemaster overseeing novice training at the Den in the Valley of Trials, tasks young warriors and adventurers with this trial.
faq.q: Who assigns Sting of the Scorpid?

faq.answer: Scorpid workers dwell in large numbers directly northwest of the Den in the Valley of Trials, roaming the arid red canyon terrain.
Gornek demands ten Scorpid Worker Tails as tangible proof that a recruit has faced the venomous beasts and emerged victorious in battle.
faq.q: What does Gornek require from the hunt?

faq.answer: The antidote for scorpid stings is brewed directly from venom extracted from the creatures' own stingers. The Den keeps ample stores on hand to treat novices who underestimate their prey.
faq.q: How is the antidote for scorpid venom created?

faq.answer: Gornek uses the hunt to teach novice fighters that any opponent, large or small, possesses lethal potential. Overconfidence in battle against seemingly minor creatures can quickly prove fatal.
faq.q: What lesson does Gornek want recruits to learn?

aliases: what after sting of the scorpid
faq.answer: Upon delivering the tails, Gornek declares he has nothing left to teach you at the Den, sending you forward into Durotar to continue your service to the Horde.
faq.q: Does Gornek offer further training after this hunt?

sections.body: In the sun-baked canyon of the Valley of Trials, Gornek tests novice Horde recruits by sending them against the local wildlife. The venomous scorpids roaming the arid dirt northwest of the Den have humbled seasoned warriors and clumsy initiates alike. To prove their battlefield competence, young champions must venture into the rocks, slay scorpid workers, and return with ten of their severed tails as proof of prowess.
sections.title: Trial of the Stinger

sections.body: While deadly, the venomous predators also supply the very salvation of injured initiates. The Den maintains stockpiles of antivenom brewed directly from extracted scorpid venom to treat fallen novices. Beyond surviving the venom, Gornek emphasizes a core tactical truth: in the chaos of battle, arrogance is fatal, and even the smallest foe wields enough lethal venom to bring down a mighty warrior.
sections.title: Venom and Vigilance

summary: Sting of the Scorpid is an early trial assigned by Gornek to Horde recruits at the Den in the Valley of Trials. Novices are challenged to hunt venomous scorpid workers northwest of camp and return ten tails to prove their combat readiness. The task serves as a vital lesson in surviving battlefield hazards and respecting even the smallest adversaries.
attribution: In-game quest text: Sting of the Scorpid
